## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what users observe after this change. English or Korean is welcome.

## Validation

List relevant checks and outcomes. State any checks that were not run and why. For documentation changes, check links, commands, and English/Korean consistency.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe migration, configuration, protocol, or permission changes, if any. Link related issues. Exclude real deployment domains, credentials, account exports, and private browser artifacts.
